latest_release.body:
### Breaking Changes 🛠

- (apidocs) Declare the API base path in the spec's server URL by @BYK with @sentry-junior in [#131065](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/131065)
- (typing) Enforce strict mypy across Sentry's Python codebase (types only) by @joshuarli with @sentry-junior in [#129614](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129614)

### New Features ✨

#### Aci

- Allow equations in span metric monitors behind a flag by @mrduncan with @sentry-junior in [#130742](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130742)
- Only query "alert" Worfklow.type on frontend by @RudraPatel2003 in [#129272](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129272)
- Update workflow engine documentation for Workflow.type by @RudraPatel2003 in [#129271](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129271)
- Handle Workflow type in secondary callers by @RudraPatel2003 in [#129270](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129270)
- Handle hidden workflows in detector endpoints by @RudraPatel2003 in [#129269](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129269)
- Handle Workflow type field on API endpoints by @RudraPatel2003 with @getsantry in [#129268](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129268)
- Add type/organization index to Workflow table by @RudraPatel2003 in [#129267](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129267)
- Add type field to Workflow model by @RudraPatel2003 in [#129266](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129266)
- Fix DataError in uptime check-ins by @RudraPatel2003 in [#129974](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129974)

#### Admin

- Add Enable Restricted Members customer action by @volokluev with @sentry-junior in [#130936](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130936)
- Allow removing a sponsorship from a customer by @noahsmartin in [#130801](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130801)
- Add a Simulate LLM usage action to customer details by @volokluev with @sentry-junior in [#130323](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130323)
- Add a modal to grant ledger credit by @volokluev and @claude in [#129809](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129809)
- Add action to set a customer's contract package by @noahsmartin in [#128965](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128965)

#### Agent Handoff

- Serve the handoff guide at /agent-handoff.md by @Abdkhan14 with @sentry-junior in [#131079](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/131079)
- Record prompt creation and claim analytics by @evanpurkhiser with @sentry-junior in [#131085](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/131085)
- Build handoff prompt on the frontend by @evanpurkhiser with @sentry-junior in [#130910](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130910)
- Verify and pin the CLI installer from the release registry by @evanpurkhiser and @BYK with @sentry-junior in [#130060](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130060)
- Return handoff code from prompt endpoint by @evanpurkhiser with @sentry-junior in [#130909](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130909)
- Use create project flow in project setup by @evanpurkhiser in [#130843](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130843)
- Add create project flow by @evanpurkhiser in [#130835](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130835)
- Add reusable setup prompt by @evanpurkhiser in [#130747](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130747)
- Add prompt copy interactions by @evanpurkhiser in [#130693](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130693)
- Copy private prompts on demand by @evanpurkhiser in [#130675](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130675)
- Add public guide previews by @evanpurkhiser with @getsantry in [#130524](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130524)
- Attach onboarding runs to private guides by @evanpurkhiser in [#130263](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130263)
- Preview setup instructions before minting by @evanpurkhiser in [#130249](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/130249)
